column1: # reads.tsv - one row per read unit, which is one file (master plan 6.1)
# uri            absolute local path, s3:// or http(s)://. Paths containing
#                spaces are preserved literally (IN07); never shell-interpolate.
# lane           lane identifier within a run. Several lanes of one library may be
#                merged, but only within the same library and read structure,
#                with mate order preserved (IN03). Mates match within run + lane.
# run            sequencing run identifier; required to distinguish reused lanes.
# bytes/checksum recorded when known; leave blank rather than guessing, so the
#                storage estimate can mark it uncertain (RS02).
